name: Buffalo Chicken Dip
desc: Hot, creamy buffalo dip of canned chicken, Frank's hot sauce, cream cheese, ranch, and cheddar, held warm in a slow cooker.

source.title: Buffalo Chicken Dip
source.evidence: Same 2 cans chicken, 2 packages cream cheese, 3/4 cup Frank's and 1 cup ranch, the same skillet then slow cooker method; this version uses more cheddar and serves it with baguette.

ingredients.raw: 2 (10 oz) cans chunk chicken breast, drained
3/4 cup Frank's RedHot Original hot sauce
2 cups shredded mild cheddar cheese, divided
2 French baguettes, sliced 1/2 inch thick, for serving

steps: Heat the chicken and hot sauce in a large skillet over medium heat, breaking up the chicken, until heated through, 3 to 5 minutes.
Stir in the cream cheese and ranch and cook, stirring, until smooth and warm, 3 to 5 minutes more.
Stir in 1 1/2 cups of the cheddar until melted. Transfer to a small slow cooker (about 3 quarts) and sprinkle the remaining 1/2 cup cheddar over the top.
Cover and cook on Low until hot and bubbly, about 35 minutes. Keep on Low or Warm for serving, with the baguette slices for dipping.
tips: Allrecipes' version uses 1 1/2 cups cheddar and serves the dip with celery sticks and crackers.

references.title: Buffalo Chicken Dip
